text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Taking the center stage is this girl right here!!
Having proven herself not only in sprints and miles, but also in medium distances—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Her GⅠ victories show no sign of stopping!
Captivating the crowd with her spectacular running, it's Taiki Shuttle!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy!
I'm gonna deliver happiness to everyone!!" Chryst

Taiki Shuttle had originally aimed to become "Umamusume of the Year"
through sprints and miles.
Showing growth beyond all expectations, she—
――Eventually, she even overcame the barrier of distance.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoooo!
Welcome back to the academyyy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! I'm super satisfied
just being able to bring happiness to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa.
Ah—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Suzuka? Aren't you tired out
after finishing your race today?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right.
I just wanted to double-check, though.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —The place I am aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The place Suzuka is aiming for...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Is that...
the view from the front, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've aimed for it all this time.
And yet, I still haven't reached it—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Because your back
is always right there ahead of me."

—On one side, a runner boasting blazing mile speed.
—On the other, a runner boasting blazing middle-distance speed.

However, as she continued to compete, Taiki Shuttle achieved
tremendous growth. Enough to rack up victories
even in middle-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
............
...Suzuka, are you happy, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy.
That I got to race Suzuka with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course, spending time with familyand hanging out with friends makes me happy too.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
“Dat is different, no!
Dis is a much more heart-warming happy, yes!”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A happiness that couldn't happen without you, Suzuka...
Do you feel it too, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, little by little,
there's something I've come to understand."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The view from the front, where no one else stands. That is—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure that alone, we could never have made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Because you're running ahead of me, it makes me determined to overtake you, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...No,
I know for sure that I'll pass them."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So the current situation—
is probably not bad for me either."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then it's OK!
AND, just what I've been waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because I know better than anyone
how strong Suzuka is!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep making even hotter happiness
from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I promise you.
—I will never, ever give up on the lead.

The bond between the two, deepened through countless battles.
Surely, none of us will be able to take our eyes off them going forward.
